# CALIBRATION.md - how far can the 'latent connection' repairs be trusted? (generated by egress/calibration_md.py)

Idea: independent documentation says which neighbourhoods really have ONE way out (Tehama County CA: 32 documented single-ingress areas) and which have several (Hays County TX: 26 one-exit, 31 multi-exit neighbourhoods). If connecting dead-end tips to a nearby unconnected road mostly repairs genuine digitising gaps, agreement with the documentation should stay or improve; if it removes the flags of documented single-exit areas, the added connections are mostly not real.

  r=  0 m | 17/26 | 1/31 | AUC 0.854 (p=2.5e-06) | 0.684 / 0.189
  r= 25 m | 17/26 | 1/31 | AUC 0.854 (p=2.5e-06) | 0.683 / 0.187

  r= 25 m | flagged 23/27 | baseline flags retained 23/24 | max load >=20 dwellings in 21/27 | Spearman(population, load) 0.84 (p=5.2e-08) | mean share single-route 0.723

## Side by side: documented single-exit flags lost by the repair
| repair radius | Hays: one-exit areas still flagged (of 26; 17 flagged at baseline) | Tehama: baseline flags retained (of 24) |
|---|---|---|
| baseline | 17 | 24 |
| 25 m | 17 | 23 |
| 50 m | 16 | 23 |
| 100 m | 11 | 23 |
| 250 m | 10 | 18 |

## Reading
* Neither label set IMPROVES with repair. At <= 25 m the effect is within +-1 flag (Hays 17 -> 17; Tehama 24 -> 23), so real digitising gaps cannot be separated from spurious touching (private drives, fences) by this check: treat the 3.9 % pooled <= 25 m flip as an UPPER BOUND on the map-induced share.
* 50 m costs one documented flag in each set (Hays 17 -> 16, Tehama 24 -> 23): the <= 50 m candidates (8-19 % of S30) are a verification list, not a correction.
* >= 100 m is not credible: Hays loses 6 of 17 documented single-exit flags at 100 m; Tehama loses 6 of 24 at 250 m and its dose-response (documented population vs graph load) collapses from Spearman 0.86 to 0.30.
* Consistent conclusion: the single-link exposure is mostly REAL (documented areas stay flagged under moderate repair), and the map-induced part is small and unproven.
* Limits: two counties, 84 neighbourhoods, flags are small integers (one flag = 4-6 %); Hays centroids are matched to the K nearest buildings, Tehama areas by road-name regex inside town boxes.
